blocks.text: Maxene Magalona was overjoyed after watching the Filipino cast-led animation film “Forgotten Island,” which features P-pop boy group SB19’s rendition of her late father, Master Rapper Francis Magalona’s hit “Mga Kababayan.” The actress, who attended an advanced screening of the DreamWorks movie, has nothing but praise as she documented her experience through her Instagram page on Sunday, Sept. 20. “Mga kababayan ko, dapat lang malaman niyo na sobrang ganda at astig ng ‘Forgotten Island’!” she said. “The movie is highly entertaining, the animation is phenomenal and the message of the story is so inspiring,” she continued. “It’s about remembering.
